brief.goal: Audit and minimally align the six named core documentation artifacts with the current unique runtime, Gate, data-contract and workbench projection mechanisms.

allowed_writes: the six explicitly named documentation artifacts
Task, Context Manifest and project control-plane status
a temporary deterministic image metadata helper that is removed before closure
forbidden_actions: runtime code, API, database, schema, View, migration or Gate semantic changes
all external platform calls and writes
all workbench runtime commands, confirmation consumption and runtime Job creation
persistence of dynamic business facts or sensitive data
validation_plan: read-only schema and database contract checks
metadata and current-mechanism assertions for all named documents
visual inspection of the updated JPG metadata strip and unchanged diagram body
JSON parse checks and git diff --check
stop_conditions: the correction requires runtime code, database, API or Gate semantic changes
a claimed data fact cannot be confirmed from current schema or read-only database truth
the JPG body would need to be regenerated rather than metadata-only extended
